parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the caller supports retry.

true: The caller supports retry. When the operation requires a retry, the response returns retry, searchRetryToken, and nextReqWaitTime.
        Boolean retry (whether a retry is required)
        String searchRetryToken (search retry token)
        Integer nextReqWaitTime (retry time interval)
        The caller must invoke the operation again based on the response and include the searchRetryToken parameter.

false: The caller does not support retry. When the operation requires a retry, the system retries internally in a loop. Risk: excessive internal retries may cause this call to timeout
parameters.help_zh:
接口调用方是否支持重试

true：表示接口调用方支持重试，当接口需要重试时
        接口会返回retry、searchRetryToken、nextReqWaitTime
        Boolean retry （是否需要重试 ）
        String searchRetryToken （搜索重试token）
        Integer nextReqWaitTime （次重试时间间隔）
        需要调用方根据返回，重新调用接口进行重试，并增加传入参数searchRetryToken

false：表示接口调用方不支持重试，当接口需要重试时
        商旅内部自己循环发起重试（风险：内部重试次数过多，可能会导致此次调用超时）
parameters.name: interface_caller_is_support_retry
